name: Jausenstation Loyastubn
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Loyastubn Jausenstation in Wildschönau!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, this cozy mountain hut offers a true taste of alpine hospitality. After a refreshing hike through the stunning **Wildschönau** valley, indulge in hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**.

The rustic charm of the Loyastubn, combined with breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps**, makes it the perfect spot to recharge. Whether you're craving a warm **Apfelstrudel** with vanilla sauce or a savory **Schlutzkrapfen** with fresh cream, every dish is crafted with love and local ingredients.

Don’t forget to try their famous **Tiroler Gröstl**—a hearty mix of potatoes, bacon, and onions, served with a side of **Brotzeit** and a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grauburgunder**.

After your meal, take a moment to relax on the sunny terrace or explore the nearby trails leading to **Innsbruck** or the **Ötztal**. The Loyastubn isn’t just a stop—it’s an experience!

**Come for the food, stay for the views.** 🏔️
